title: Bent bound for affine-sign distance
statement: Let $n$ be an even natural number, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube with $|f(x)|=1$ at every point. The normalized Hamming distance from $f$ to the family of affine sign functions is at most $\frac12-\frac{1}{2\cdot 2^{n/2}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the Boolean cube
